result.description: GTM data enrichment and prospecting platform that aggregates data providers, search, and AI into tables/workflows for sales teams.
result.auth_detail: Personal API key sent in the `clay-api-key` header; tied to a Clay user and workspace. No OAuth documented for the Public API (OAuth appears only for MCP-for-Reps client connections).
result.access_detail: Each user creates own key in app (API and CLI → API keys) or via CLI; no app review or partner status needed. Clay's university docs say the developer platform is on all plans including free (100 search results/30 days). Pricing FAQ conflicts, tying "Clay API access" to Enterprise. Tables endpoint and structured queries are Enterprise-only. Editor/Admin workspace access needed.
result.api_notes: Public API at api.clay.com/public/v0: people/company search, routines, me, and read-only Tables (Enterprise). Also Clay CLI and agent plugin. Newly launched (2026), surface still limited vs the product; table creation and writes not supported.
result.blocker: Conflicting plan docs on API access; table endpoints Enterprise-only; API surface is narrow/read-focused; MCP endpoint URL unverified on vendor pages.

evidence.quote: Every request to the Clay Public API must include a Clay API key in the `clay-api-key` header.
API keys are tied to a Clay user and workspace access.
The developer platform is available across all Clay plans, including free, trial, and Legacy plans.
Structured queries — joins, ranges, and paging past 100 rows — need API table sync, an Enterprise feature.
Includes everything in Growth, plus unlimited Audiences across sources, unlimited row bulk enrichment, Clay API access...
Tables in the Public API is read-only — you can query and read rows, but not create tables...
Use Clay with coding agents, MCP clients, local scripts, and JSON-first automations.
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is how Clay connects your workspace to AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT...
MCP for Reps is a different connection, set up separately by an admin for sellers working in chat apps and coding agents.
